Description: The Adventure-class Carrier serves as a mobile stronghold for pirate flotillas operating beyond recognized territorial space. Refitted from a civilian hull and reinforced with improvised flight decks and hangar bays, it acts as both raider command ship and strike carrier, projecting irregular power across vulnerable trade routes.

The Archaelith-class Drone is an autonomous reconnaissance platform deployed for deep-space surveillance and perimeter control. Compact and lightly armed, it relies on advanced sensor suites and networked coordination to extend fleet awareness far beyond the main battle line.

The DD/E-708 ASHER class of destroyer/escorts represents a lighter, more maneuverable alternative to the heavy Spectre class destroyers that make up the majority of Alliance destroyer squadrons.  The Asher class is armed with a trio of nose-mounted XRay Laser batteries, and a pair of wing-mounted fusion torpedo launchers, as well as the usual complement of point defense turrets.  This combination of power and agility makes the Asher class well suited to the fleet carrier escort role they are asked to fulfill

The F6F AVENGER attack fighter is a highly competent assault platform, capable of meeting most any opponent on even ground and providing an edge over the majority of enemy starfighters in service.  The Avenger is the only Hegemony craft in current service that is optimized for the ground attack role in addition to supporting antiship mission profiles.  The Avenger features a four-barrel Alpha cannon and eight (8) missile hardpoints.  However, unlike the Alliance Thunderbolt, the Avenger does not have a gun turret for rear-quarter protection.

The BAIKAL class frigates are commonly used by the independent systems as anti-fighter platforms.  Designed by the Marakan Hegemony as cost efficient space combatants, they lack the multi-mission capability necessary for modern warships faced with multiple, high-technology threats. They also offer limited capacity for growth. Despite this, the FF-101 Baikal class is a robust platform, capable of withstanding considerable damage while staying 'in the fight.'

The Barracks Facility is a hardened surface installation responsible for housing and coordinating ground security forces within contested sectors. Though lightly defended, it serves as a strategic anchor point for planetary operations, reinforcing stability and projecting imperial authority across the region.

The FF-922 BERENTS class frigates fulfill a Protection of Shipping (POS) mission providing anti-fighter cover for amphibious expeditionary forces, underway replenishment groups and merchant convoys.  The Berents class anti-fighter weapons complement includes two forward plus one aft Phalanx PDB mounts, along with a pair of Mark VII interceptor launchers.  The Berents class was also recently upgraded to include a heavy plasma cannon battery for use against harder targets.

The BioDome is a self-contained ecological habitat engineered to sustain life in otherwise hostile environments. Serving as both agricultural hub and civilian sanctuary, it represents the fragile but persistent expansion of humanity into the frontier.

The Utility Dome is a modular support installation designed to house power regulation, environmental processing, and logistical infrastructure for nearby settlements. Though unassuming in profile, it forms the operational backbone that keeps frontier colonies functioning under extreme conditions.

The Elevated Bridge is a reinforced transit structure spanning hazardous terrain to link critical installations across a colony zone. Built for durability rather than elegance, it enables secure troop movement, cargo transfer, and rapid response between strategic ground assets.

The Office Complex serves as the administrative nerve center of a planetary settlement, coordinating logistics, communications, and civil governance. While lightly fortified, its data networks and command infrastructure make it a vital asset in maintaining operational control across the sector.

The Office Tower rises above the surrounding settlement as a centralized hub for commercial and administrative operations. Though not a military structure, its communications arrays and data archives make it strategically significant during periods of unrest or occupation.

This facility is a standard modular structure commonly deployed in expanding colony zones. Adaptable to multiple civil or logistical roles, it provides essential infrastructure support while maintaining a compact defensive footprint.

This facility is a prefabricated support structure used to reinforce developing settlements and industrial outposts. Designed for rapid deployment and low maintenance, it quietly sustains the operational backbone of frontier expansion.

The Office Tower stands as a prominent administrative and commercial structure within the colonyﾒs urban district. Beyond its civilian fa￧ade, its communications relays and data centers make it a strategically valuable objective during regional conflicts.

The Bldg05 Facility is a multipurpose colonial structure supporting logistics, storage, and essential services within developing settlements. Though architecturally modest, it plays a quiet but critical role in sustaining long-term planetary operations.

The DD-3C21 BROADSWORD class of destroyers represents the pinnacle of Hegemony warship technology; big, fast, and ready to deliver punishing amounts of damage to all who stand in their way.  The Broadsword class ships extend the basic armament of the older Volnaris class by doubling the number of heavy x-ray laser batteries to four.  As with many Hegemony designs, these weapons are externally mounted and vulnerable to attack from the flanks.

The CameraPod Drone is a compact autonomous observation unit deployed for perimeter surveillance and battlefield monitoring. Lightly armored and unarmed, it relays real-time visual and sensor telemetry to command elements, extending tactical awareness without risking crewed assets.

The IM3500 Freighter is a heavy cargo hauler designed for sustained interstellar trade routes and bulk resource transport. Slow but resilient, it prioritizes capacity and range over combat capability, often operating under escort in volatile sectors.

The IM4300 Hauler is a mid-capacity transport optimized for regional supply distribution and frontier logistics. More maneuverable than larger freight platforms, it balances cargo volume with operational flexibility across unstable trade corridors.

The IM2800 Cargo Hauler is a compact commercial transport built for short-range freight delivery and orbital resupply operations. Designed for efficiency and low operating cost, it is a common sight along established trade lanes and developing colony routes.

The City Block represents a dense urban sector composed of residential, commercial, and light industrial structures. While primarily civilian in function, its infrastructure and population density make it strategically significant during planetary occupations or urban engagements.

The City Block is a clustered urban district supporting residential habitation and local commerce within the colony grid. Though non-military in purpose, control of such sectors is often decisive in maintaining planetary stability and civil authority.

The City Block is a compact urban sector integrating housing, utilities, and municipal services within a fortified colony perimeter. Though outwardly civilian, its infrastructure corridors and transit routes can become critical objectives during ground operations.

The City Block is a fully developed metropolitan sector featuring integrated habitation towers, transit corridors, and municipal support systems. Standardized across multiple colonies, it represents the core of civilian life and economic continuity, making its preservationﾗor controlﾗa decisive factor in planetary campaigns.

The MARK-3 COBRA is a mid-wing configuration multi-role fighter spacecraft that was once commonly used by the Marakan Hegemony but now is mainly used by its client states. The Cobra is a tough and effective single-engine spacecraft that is frequently employed against all types of hardened ground targets, and may also fulfill a secondary role killing spaceborne platforms and starships. The Cobra is armed with twin nose-mounted Alpha particle cannon, along with eight underwing hard points capable of mounting several types of anti-fighter, antiship, and ground-attack weapon systems.

The Colony Ship is a massive interstellar ark designed to transport settlers, equipment, and prefabricated infrastructure to distant worlds. Though lightly armed and slow to maneuver, it carries the promise of expansionﾗits survival often shaping the fate of entire frontier systems.

The Cooling Tower is an industrial support structure responsible for thermal regulation of planetary power plants and heavy manufacturing facilities. While not a combat installation, its destruction can cripple energy production and destabilize critical infrastructure across the colony.

Modern Terrelian guided missile cruisers such as the CA-521 COURAGEOUS class perform primarily in a Battle Force role. These ships are multi-mission spaceborne combatants capable of supporting carrier battle groups, landing forces, or of operating independently and as flagships of space action groups. The Courageous class features four MARK VII interceptor launchers for close air support against fighters and inbound missiles.  Courageous class cruisers are also equipped with Nike high-speed antiship missiles giving them additional long range assault capability.

The Courier-class Blockade Runner is a fast-response transport designed to slip through contested space under minimal escort. Built for endurance and discretion rather than firepower, it excels at moving critical personnel, intelligence, and high-value cargo through unstable frontier sectors.

Small, stealthy, and highly maneuverable, the CUTLASS pirate fighter is commonly used by the Brotherhood of Iron criminal organization as both a commerce raider and escort for their larger vessels.  The Cutlass features four widely spread Alpha cannon, and has even been known to mount stolen antiship missiles for some engagements.

The CA-400 DEVASTATOR class of heavy cruisers forms the backbone of the Alliance heavy gun capability.  Big, slow, and very tough, each of these enormous vessels features a pair of heavy gamma ray laser batteries and four Athena missile launchers.  Together these weapons can bring down the largest starships and orbital stations.  For defense against strike ships and inbound missile weapons, the Devastator has full coverage from a set of Vanguard point defense batteries.

The CV-7A1 DRAGON class carriers represent the pinnacle of Hegemony military starship design. Though somewhat slow and unweildy, the Dragons are nevertheless enormously powerful.  Their huge complement of embarked fighter craft give them unparalleled force projection capability; a single Dragon-class carrier battle group could easily conquer a colonial world.

A Deserted Building is an abandoned colonial structure left behind after failed expansion or evacuation. Though officially inactive, such ruins often conceal salvageable technology, hidden supply caches, or unexpected tactical hazards.

A Deserted Building is an abandoned colonial structure left behind after failed expansion or evacuation. Though officially inactive, such ruins often conceal salvageable technology, hidden supply caches, or unexpected tactical hazards.

A Deserted Building is an abandoned colonial structure left behind after failed expansion or evacuation. Though officially inactive, such ruins often conceal salvageable technology, hidden supply caches, or unexpected tactical hazards.

A Deserted Building is an abandoned colonial structure left behind after failed expansion or evacuation. Though officially inactive, such ruins often conceal salvageable technology, hidden supply caches, or unexpected tactical hazards.

A Deserted Outpost is a remote installation abandoned after resource depletion or strategic withdrawal. Weathered by time and exposure, it stands as a silent relic of past expansionﾗoccasionally repurposed by scavengers, pirates, or covert operatives.

A Deserted Minehead is a surface extraction hub marking the primary access point to subterranean resource veins. Once vital to industrial output, it often becomes a contested objective when rare minerals or strategic materials are at stake.

The F-34D EAGLE is a compact, multi-role fighter spacecraft. It is highly maneuverable and has proven itself in spaceborne and airborne combat as well as in surface attack missions. It provides a relatively low-cost, high-performance weapon system for Alliance forces.   Like the F-32 Falcon, the Eagle is armed with twin Delta particle cannon, along with four underwing hard points capable of mounting a variety of anti-fighter ordnance.  The Eagle's heavier structure also provides support for air-to-ground and antiship weapons and increased survivability at some cost in overall maneuverability.

The Assembly Works specializes in modular fabrication and rapid component integration for vehicles and structural systems. Optimized for efficiency, it supports frontline logistics through high-volume standardized production.

The Industrial Processing Plant (BLDG) refines raw materials into usable alloys, composites, and mechanical subassemblies. Positioned near extraction hubs, it forms the first stage of large-scale planetary manufacturing.

The Advanced Fabrication Center (BLDG) produces precision components and specialized hardware for military and aerospace applications. Its automated lines and controlled environments enable the construction of high-tolerance systems.

The Fleet Support Foundry (BLDG) manufactures reinforced hull plating, structural frames, and heavy ship components for orbital deployment. As a strategic industrial node, its output directly enhances regional fleet readiness.

The Factory is a large-scale industrial installation dedicated to the fabrication of armored hull sections, propulsion assemblies, and heavy equipment. Its reinforced infrastructure and continuous-output production lines make it a strategic cornerstone for sustaining fleet and ground operations.

The F-32 FALCON is the premier single-seat intercept fighter craft for the Alliance FORCE:Space.  Designed to be lightweight, low cost and easy to maintain, the Falcon is a respected highly maneuverable and versatile tactical fighter.  It is armed with twin Delta particle cannon, and four underwing hard points capable of mounting a variety of anti-fighter ordnance.  The Falcon is routinely tasked with patrol, escort, and intercept mission profiles.

The standard Terellian Alliance quantum portal for long range travel.  The 185 exawatt Type I FARCASTER can translate any starship or fighter-class vessel, even without an onboard FTL quantum drive, instantly to a remote destination.  Farcaster portals are always connected in pairs.

The standard Hegemony quantum portal for long range travel.  The Type II FARCASTER can translate any starship or fighter-class vessel instantly to a remote destination.  Type II Farcaster portals may found throughout the systems controlled by the Marakan Hegemony.

Tiger Bay Base is a Marakan strategic starbase positioned to support rapid fleet mobilization and sustained regional control. Featuring fortified docking arrays and layered defense systems, it serves as both a logistical nexus and a hardened military bastion for the Hegemony.

The Fortress is a heavily fortified orbital stronghold operated by the Terellian Alliance. Equipped with layered defensive grids, interceptor bays, and long-range sensor arrays, it serves as both regional command center and immovable bastion guarding critical trade corridors.

The Freight Transfer Station is a Terellian-operated orbital logistics hub dedicated to cargo transfer and commercial redistribution. Though lightly armed, its docking arrays and storage rings make it a vital artery in maintaining steady trade flow across Alliance space.

The AAA Gun is a ground-based anti-aerospace defense platform designed to protect strategic installations from low-altitude strikes and orbital bombardment. Compact and rapid-tracking, it provides layered perimeter security against fighters, drones, and incoming munitions.

The Quad AAA Gun is a four-barrel anti-aerospace defense system engineered for high-volume intercept fire against fast-moving targets. Its synchronized tracking array and overlapping firing arcs make it especially effective against fighter swarms and precision strike craft.

The Surface-to-Air Missile Battery is a rapid-response air defense platform designed to engage hostile fighters and inbound strike craft at medium range. Equipped with autonomous tracking and salvo-launch capability, it provides layered protection for installations and fleet staging areas.

The GOLIATH class carrier vessels provide the Dantari Separatists with their main force projection capability in the Solus system.  Unlike the rest of the Dantari fleet, which consists largely of older Hegemony warships, the Goliath class carriers were designed and constructed specifically for their Dantari crew.  Due to budgetary constraints, the Goliath class is outfitted with only a single launch rail, but still has a full complement of point defense batteries for close-in protection.

Harmony Station is a Terellian Alliance diplomatic and logistics outpost positioned along key commercial corridors. Designed as both a civilian sanctuary and fleet support node, it combines modular docking rings with defensive shielding to safeguard Alliance trade and regional stability.

Marakan Hegemony guided missile cruisers such as the CA-5C44 IMPERIAL class are most often found leading small cruiser battle groups. These ships are devastating attack platforms, equally at home either support or leading space action groups. The Imperial class features a pair of Rostov high-speed missile turrets, which combined with a full battery of magnetic rail launchers, gives them excellent long range assault capability.

The F4F INTRUDER is the latest edition single-seat intercept fighter craft used by the Marakan Hegemony.  More expensive than the older Viper models, the Intruder remains a lightweight and highly maneuverable tactical fighter.  It is armed with twin Alpha particle cannon, and four underwing hard points capable of mounting a variety of antiship and anti-fighter ordnance.  The Intruder is usually tasked with patrol, intercept, and escort mission profiles, but may also serve as a strike fighter in a pinch.

The JACKAL armored landing craft (LCA) is the mainstay of Hegemony heavy-lift capacity, and the only Marakan craft capable of atmospheric VTOL.  The Jackal is commonly used to ferry personnel and equipment between groundside bases and spaceborne platforms, and also serves a secondary role in heavy assault profiles.  The Jackal is armed with twin heavy Vulcan cannon, but is limited to standard decoy launchers for self-defense.

Telmera Starport is a major Independent Solus orbital hub facilitating civilian trade, diplomatic traffic, and limited defensive patrol operations. While not as heavily fortified as military installations, its strategic position and traffic volume make it a vital crossroads within neutral space.

The MARAUDER is a small frigate-class vessel commonly used by the Brotherhood of Iron criminal organization as a commerce raider.  The Marauder ships are no match for most military warships, but they make up for their limitations with enhanced stealth capabilities.  Starship captains usually find the Marauder to be a fiendishly difficult type of ship to lock onto.

The Blockade Mine is a concealed proximity explosive deployed to deny access to strategic corridors and orbital approaches. Triggered by hostile signatures, it delivers a devastating detonation capable of crippling even heavily armored vessels.

The Tal Vesta Stellar Observatory is a premier Terellian astrophysics station positioned in high orbit to monitor stellar activity and deep-space anomalies. Its expansive sensor lattice and quantum analysis suites make it a cornerstone of Alliance scientific research and early-warning defense networks.

The CV-69 ORION class carriers are essentially spaceborne starports, capable of launching as many as four fighter craft every minute. The Orion's two launch rails and two arresting gear engines enable her to launch and recover ships both rapidly and simultaneously. The Orion class ship's embarked tactical fighter wing includes four different types of fighter and attack craft in addition to armored landing craft for a total complement of almost 80 ships.

A platform is a reinforced surface installation used as a modular support structure for sensors, light weapons, or cargo operations. Though modest in profile, it serves as a critical tactical foothold in contested zones and developing colonies.

The Q-Ship masquerades as a standard civilian freighter, concealing reinforced hull plating and hidden weapon emplacements beneath its commercial facade. Favored by pirate raiders and covert operators alike, it lures hostile forces into close range before revealing its true, heavily armed nature.

The F5A RAPTOR is a swept-delta configuration multi-role fighter spacecraft commonly used by the Marakan Hegemony.  It is fast and sturdy and has proven itself in spaceborne and airborne combat as well as in surface attack missions. The Raptor is armed with twin Alpha particle cannon, along with eight underwing hard points capable of mounting several types of anti-fighter ordnance.  The Razor's heavy delta wing design also gives it the capacity to mount a variety of air-to-ground and antiship weapons.

The MARK-2 RAZOR is a forward-delta configuration multi-role fighter spacecraft commonly used by the Marakan Hegemony and its client states. It is fast and sturdy and has proven itself in spaceborne and airborne combat as well as in surface attack missions. Like the Mark 1 Viper, the Razor is armed with twin Alpha particle cannon, along with eight underwing hard points capable of mounting several types of anti-fighter ordnance.  The Razor's heavy delta wing design also gives it the capacity to mount a variety of air-to-ground and antiship weapons.

The Generator Complex provides primary power distribution for planetary installations and orbital facilities alike. Hardened against bombardment and sabotage, its reactor core feeds surrounding structures with stable, high-output energy essential for sustained operations.

The Communications Relay Satellite serves as a long-range signal repeater, extending fleet communications across contested sectors. Though lightly armored, its strategic value makes it a priority target in any system-wide engagement.

The Marakan Orbital Station functions as a regional logistics and command hub, coordinating fleet traffic and resource distribution throughout nearby sectors. While less fortified than a fortress installation, it maintains sufficient defenses to deter opportunistic strikes.

The Marakan Freight Transfer Station is a high-throughput cargo interchange positioned along major trade routes. Massive docking gantries and automated handling arrays allow it to rapidly offload, inspect, and redistribute materials to support sustained fleet operations.

The Marakan Military Research Station is a secured orbital laboratory dedicated to advanced weapons testing and prototype systems development. Shielded compartments and restricted access decks conceal experimental technologies intended to give the Hegemony a decisive battlefield advantage.

The Saber F-22 is a high-performance Marakan space superiority fighter built for rapid interception and precision strikes. Agile and heavily armed for its size, it forms the backbone of frontline carrier wings throughout the Hegemony.

The Senate Complex is the political heart of the region, housing legislative chambers and administrative offices. Though architecturally imposing and symbolically powerful, it relies on surrounding defenses for protection during times of conflict.

The DD-350 SPECTRE class of destroyers represent the largest and most successful of all Alliance Space Force destroyer acquisitions: fast, roomy, capable of absorbing enormous punishment, and yet fighting on.  The Spectre class ships are forty percent heavier than their Asher class cousins, and they use the extra mass to great effect.  The Spectre class features four nose-mounted XRay Laser batteries, and a pair of wing-mounted fusion torpedo launchers in addition to four Phalanx point defense guns.

The F-36C STORMHAWK is a compact, multi-role fighter spacecraft. It is highly maneuverable and has proven itself in spaceborne and airborne combat as well as in surface attack missions. It provides a relatively low-cost, high-performance weapon system for Alliance forces.   Like the F-32 Falcon, the Stormhawk is armed with twin Delta particle cannon, along with four underwing hard points capable of mounting a variety of anti-fighter ordnance.  The Stormhawk's heavier structure also provides support for air-to-ground and antiship weapons and increased survivability at some cost in overall maneuverability.

Tanis Base is a Dantari deep-space stronghold serving as a coordination hub for fleet patrols and supply convoys. Its reinforced superstructure and dispersed command sectors allow it to remain operational even under sustained assault.

The Cryo Tank Facility stores volatile compounds and cryogenically preserved materials essential for industrial processing and fleet resupply. Its reinforced containment structures are designed to prevent catastrophic chain reactions in the event of attack.

The IM1906 Tanker is a heavy-capacity fuel transport vessel engineered for long-haul logistics operations. Though lightly armed, its reinforced storage cells and extended range make it indispensable to sustained fleet deployments.

The IM1912 Tanker is an upgraded deep-space refueling vessel optimized for rapid transfer operations under escort. Its modular containment systems allow it to transport refined propellants and volatile fuels safely across contested sectors.

The Class 2 TARGET DRONE is a high midwing monoplane of conventional design with an inverted-Y empennage. The spaceframe is a modified monocoque structure made of a titanium alloy-reinforced ceramic composite. The Target is powered by a FP387/403 variable speed fusion drive, which produces a maximum of 4T static thrust under normal operating conditions.  The Target is equipped with a fighter-style sensor package and onboard AI pilot capability, but is otherwise unarmed.

The F/A-38D THUNDERBOLT is the primary Alliance attack craft, and the first specially designed for close air support of ground forces. They are tough, effective and powerful four-engine spacecraft that can be used against all ground targets, as well as fulfilling a secondary role in killing spaceborne platforms and starships.  The 'Bolt has six underwing hardpoints for standard attack ordnance, as well as dual front-mounted Heavy Energy Cannon.  For rear protection from hostile fighters and high-speed threats, the Thunderbolt features an autonomous tail gun turret.

The FF-2E01 TIGER BAY class frigate was the result of war department opposition to mounting costs and limited capabilities of the older Baikal class frigate.  Only fourteen Baikal class ships were built, and all were decommissioned and sold to neighboring independent systems.  The Tiger Bay class was designed to extend the anti-ship capabilities of the older frigates by adding a pair of light x-ray laser batteries mounted on the wings.  As with many Hegemony designs, these weapons are externally mounted and vulnerable to attack from the flanks.

The Transport Courier is a compact multi-role vessel used for personnel transfer, priority cargo delivery, and diplomatic movement between systems. Lightly armed but highly reliable, it serves as a dependable utility craft for both military and civilian operations.

The CA-5D15 VENDETTA class of heavy cruisers are the core Hegemony heavy gun platforms.  Big, slow, and very tough, each of these enormous vessels features a pair of heavy gamma ray laser batteries and twin Rostov antiship missile turrets.  Together these weapons can bring down the largest starships and orbital stations.  The Vendetta's complement of magnetic rail guns make her more suitable to offense than defense; these ships rely on their tough hide to withstand enemy bombardment while they move in for the kill.

The MARK-1 VIPER is an older model single-seat intercept fighter craft used by the Marakan Hegemony and many of its client states.  Designed to be inexpensive, lightweight, and highly maneuverable, the Viper has become ubiquitous as a versatile tactical fighter.  It is armed with twin Alpha particle cannon, and six underwing hard points capable of mounting a variety of anti-fighter ordnance.  The Viper is often asked to perform patrol, intercept, and escort mission profiles.

The DD/E-4D01 VOLNARIS class of destroyer/escorts are the predecessors of the heavier Broadsword destroyer class.  Originally intended as mainline destroyers, the Volnaris ships have now been relegated primarily to escort duty for the Hegemony battle groups.  The Volnaris features a pair of internally-mounted heavy x-ray laser batteries and three fusion torpedo launchers for offensive capability, along with a full complement of Orca point defense batteries for protection from inbound threats.  Due to design limitations, the Orca PDBs tend to provide better coverage for the dorsal hemisphere, leaving the Volnaris class with a vulnerable underbelly.

The DD-305 WOLF class of medium destroyers are an older type of Hegemony warship now mainly used by client states and guerilla groups such as the Dantari Separatists.  The Wolf class features a pair of internally-mounted heavy XRay Laser batteries and a full complement of Orca point defense batteries for protection from inbound threats.  Due to design limitations, the Orca PDBs tend to provide better coverage for the dorsal hemisphere, leaving the Wolf class with a vulnerable underbelly.

The ZODIAC armored landing craft (LCA) is the standard Alliance millitary shuttle platform, and the only Force:Space craft capable of atmospheric VTOL.  The Zodiac is commonly used to ferry personnel and equipment between groundside bases and spaceborne platforms.  The Zodiac is armed with four (4) heavy Vulcan cannon, and an aft-mounted automated laser turret for self-defense.

The ZZA Attack Craft is a compact Zolon assault fighter designed for high-velocity strike runs against capital targets. Though lightly shielded, its forward-mounted weapons and aggressive maneuver profile make it a dangerous adversary in close engagements.

The ZZCA Zolon Cruiser is a mid-range warship built to enforce Zolon dominance across contested space. Equipped with heavy beam arrays and layered shielding, it serves as both a fleet escort and an independent strike platform in extended campaigns.

The ZZCS Zolon Consul is a command-grade cruiser that serves as both diplomatic envoy and battle leader within Zolon task forces. Outfitted with advanced sensor suites and reinforced defensive systems, it coordinates fleet actions while projecting Zolon authority across disputed systems.

The ZZDD Zolon Destroyer is a fast-attack capital ship engineered for aggressive forward operations. Armed with concentrated strike batteries and reinforced hull plating, it excels at flanking maneuvers and rapid assault engagements in support of larger Zolon formations.

The ZZF Zolon Fighter is a nimble interceptor craft deployed in large numbers to overwhelm opposing squadrons. Compact and ruthlessly efficient, it relies on speed and coordinated attack patterns to secure local space superiority.

The ZZFF Zolon Frigate is a versatile escort vessel designed to screen larger warships and patrol contested corridors. Combining moderate firepower with durable shielding, it forms the backbone of Zolon mid-range fleet operations.

The Blockade Mine is a concealed proximity explosive deployed to deny access to strategic corridors and orbital approaches. Triggered by hostile signatures, it delivers a devastating detonation capable of crippling even heavily armored vessels.

Built into a rock at the edge of Janek's asteroid field, the Asteroid Base buffers ore shipments from the mining station. It has storage for 90,000 tonnes, two external freight berths, and one enclosed bay for launch and recovery. Ore shuttles load here for delivery to Janus Transfer Station.

The ring-shaped Mining Station operates inside Janek's asteroid field. Its crews survey nearby deposits, extract ore and sort concentrates for shipment to the Asteroid Base. It has storage for 90,000 tonnes and two external freight berths. Visiting craft berth externally.
An orbital refinery that processes ore delivered from local mining depots. External berths accept bulk shipments and finished concentrate awaits collection in shared storage.
A civilian Zodiac conversion with a 48-tonne ore hold and a forward industrial mining laser. Built for short runs between a deposit and a transfer berth.
A civilian IM3500 mining conversion with three industrial lasers and 12,000 tonnes of ore capacity.

Foothill Base is a Dantari forward-operating starbase constructed to support insurgent fleet movements and rapid strike operations. Built into a defensible orbital position, it combines concealed approach vectors with hardened hangars to sustain prolonged resistance campaigns.

Janek Station is a Terellian frontier starbase serving as a forward staging ground for fighter wings and patrol flotillas. Its expansive hangar bays and hardened defensive grid make it a critical anchor point along the Allianceﾒs outer perimeter.

Radix Base is a Marakan strategic starbase positioned to support rapid fleet mobilization and sustained regional control. Featuring fortified docking arrays and layered defense systems, it serves as both a logistical nexus and a hardened military bastion for the Hegemony.
